Everything You Need to Run Your Institution

Purpose-built modules that work together seamlessly. No bloat, no unnecessary features.

Multi-Tenant Architecture

Complete data isolation per institution. Each college operates in its own secure environment with zero cross-tenant access.

Workflow Automation

Built-in approval chains for OD requests and marks. Faculty → HOD → Admin flows with full audit trails.

Compliance Engine

Generate semester summaries and regulatory exports (CSV/PDF) with one click. No manual report building.

Role-Based Dashboards

5 distinct user roles with tailored views. Each user sees only what they need — nothing more, nothing less.

Real-Time Analytics

Live attendance tracking with automatic defaulter flagging. Subject-wise performance breakdowns at a glance.

Enterprise Security

Firebase JWT authentication, role-based access controls, tenant-level query filtering. Zero trust by default.

How It Works

Get your institution up and running in four simple steps.

Step 01

Onboard Institution

Step 02
